title: Create trycmd tests for flow command
description:
Add comprehensive integration tests for flow visualization using trycmd:

Test scenarios:
- Basic text output with simple chain
- SVG generation (verify file created, basic structure)
- JSON export structure validation
- DOT export format
- Empty repository (no dependencies)
- Various graph patterns (from test fixtures)
- --show-done flag behavior
- --goal flag with critical path highlighting
- Error cases: invalid goal ID, circular dependencies

Pattern: tests/workflows/flow-*.trycmd

Ensure tests are:
- Fast (use small test fixtures)
- Stable (pattern match dynamic content like UUIDs)
- Comprehensive (cover main use cases and edge cases)
